entries.a: The CPU is the processor, the main chip that does the computing.
The GPU is the graphics processor. It draws the pictures, and it's what your game leans on most.
RAM is your computer's short term memory. More of it lets you run more things at once.
An SSD is a fast storage drive with no moving parts. Games load much quicker from one.
FPS means frames per second. The higher it is, the smoother the game looks.
Virtual reality uses a headset to put you inside the game, so you can look around the cockpit.
Artificial intelligence is software that does things that normally need human thinking, like understanding speech. Like me, in a small way.
Wi-Fi is wireless networking that connects your devices to the internet.
The internet is a worldwide network of computers that talk to each other.
A kilobyte is about a thousand bytes, and a megabyte about a thousand kilobytes.
Streaming means broadcasting your game live over the internet, like you do.
Twitch is a live streaming website, mostly for games.
Python is a programming language. I'm written in it, as it happens.
Programming is writing instructions that a computer can follow.
